title: Senior Thermal Vacuum Test Engineer
description: Your tasks: plan and run thermal vacuum tests of satellite payloads in our cleanroom, correlate the thermal model with the measured data, and support the integration and verification campaign. You bring a degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering, several years of TVAC experience and good English and German. We offer flexible working hours and a company pension scheme.

title: Lead Propulsion Engineer
description: About the role: you lead a team of six engineers developing cryogenic thruster injectors and turbopump components. You own the combustion test campaigns, set the requirements with the systems team and report to the programme manager. Requirements: MSc in aerospace engineering, experience with rocket engine test campaigns, French or English.
